tools.description: Research any topic with fact extraction. Returns verified claims ready for script generation. Works for any content type: tech, cooking, travel, history, tutorials, etc.

tools.name: write_script
tools.description: Write a video script from research claims. Generic — works for any topic, style, language, or format. Returns structured scene JSON.

tools.name: generate_scene_image
tools.description: Registers or generates a code-driven visual card for one scene. FrameForge uses 100% code-driven animation and user media instead of diffusion.

tools.name: assemble_video
tools.description: Assemble rendered scenes into a final MP4. Runs quality gate before returning.

description.description: Video description for metadata and webhook payload

tools.name: ingest_media
tools.description: Ingest user-supplied video clips, images, and/or audio files into a scenes manifest. No AI generation — edit-only entry point. Returns { productionId, scenesFile, sceneCount }.

scenes.description: Inline scene array. Each scene: { narration, caption, video_path, image_path, audio_path, camera_hint, music_mood }

scenesFile.description: Path to a scenes.json file on disk

tools.name: edit_scenes
tools.description: Read and optionally modify an existing scenes manifest. Use to add/update narration, captions, camera hints, or swap media files before rendering.

edits.description: Array of { sceneIndex: number, field: string, value: any } patches to apply

appendScenes.description: New scenes to append to the manifest

tools.name: render_from_scenes
tools.description: Render a video directly from a scenes manifest, skipping research and script generation. Supply a productionId from ingest_media, or pass scenes inline.

skipImages.description: Skip AI image generation (use video_path / image_path in scenes)

skipTts.description: Skip TTS synthesis (use audio_path in scenes)

topic.description: Overall topic/genre for visual theme and aesthetic selection

style.description: Visual style/theme override (e.g. cinematic_documentary, finance_executive, cyber_tech, retro_synthwave, nature_organic, hype_sports, minimal_luxury, breaking_news, cosmic_space)

language.description: BCP-47 language hint (e.g. ml, hi, en, ta)

showCaptions.description: Display on-screen synchronized subtitles/captions. Default false.

tools.name: external_platform_call
tools.description:
Call any external platform or custom MCP-compatible app via HTTP — no env vars required when you pass platformUrl directly.

Works with any app that exposes an HTTP API: your own custom editor, VoxForge, Runway, Kling, Pika, Remotion, ElevenLabs, or anything you build.

Actions:
  ingest   — upload/import files (POST multipart to the platform)
  edit     — send an operations array to drive editing in the app
  render   — send scenes or a render job request
  status   — poll a job by jobId
  download — fetch a remote URL to a local file

Named presets (set EXTERNAL_PLATFORM_NAME to one of these and omit platformUrl):
  voxforge, elevenlabs, runway, kling, pika, remotion, premiere, resolve, capcut, aftereffects

action.description: ingest: upload files | edit: send operations to drive the app | render: submit render job | status: poll job | download: fetch output

platformUrl.description: Base URL of the target app/platform (e.g. http://localhost:8080 or https://api.myapp.io). Overrides EXTERNAL_PLATFORM_URL. Pass this to connect any custom app without touching .env.

platformKey.description: API key or bearer token for the platform. Overrides EXTERNAL_PLATFORM_KEY.

platformName.description: Named preset to use (voxforge|elevenlabs|runway|kling|premiere|resolve|capcut|aftereffects|remotion). When set, default paths are applied automatically.

operations.description: Edit operations array (for action=edit). Each: { op, clip?, at?, between?, type?, duration?, text?, ... }

outputPath.description: Local path to save download (for action=download)

metadata.description: Extra fields forwarded to the platform

tools.name: create_video_from_script
tools.description:
Agent-first video creation. YOU (the IDE agent) provide the complete scenes array — FrameForge renders it.
Features:
- Code-driven animation and kinetic typography by default (broadcast quality, zero AI artifacts).
- Supports direct agent/user code: pass "html" (complete page with window.seek(t)) or "code" (canvas drawing instructions for t).
- Procedural full-canvas cinematic animations (celestial orbits, DNA helices, candlestick charts, neural nets, 3D wireframe geometry).
- Supports manual user clips (video_path) and manual images (image_path).
- No internal LLM or research required. Primary path for Claude Code, IBM Bob, Cursor, and any agentic IDE.

Example scene:
{
  "narration": "The text spoken aloud in this scene",
  "caption": "OVERLAY TEXT",
  "visual_description": "Description of the scene visual / animation",
  "html": "<!doctype html>... window.seek = async (t) => { ... }",
  "code": "/* canvas drawing code for t */",
  "camera_hint": "zoom_in",
  "music_mood": "energetic",
  "image_path": "/optional/your/own/image.jpg",
  "video_path": "/optional/your/own/clip.mp4",
  "audio_path": "/optional/your/own/voice.mp3"
}

scenes.description: Complete scenes array written by the agent. Each scene: { narration, caption, visual_description, html?, code?, camera_hint?, music_mood?, image_path?, video_path?, audio_path?, voice? }

voice.description: edge-tts voice ID for all scenes, e.g. "ml-IN-MidhunNeural" (Malayalam male), "en-US-BrianNeural" (English). Per-scene voice field overrides this. Full list: edge-tts --list-voices

language.description: BCP-47 language hint, e.g. "ml" (Malayalam), "hi" (Hindi), "ta" (Tamil), "te" (Telugu), "en" (English). Auto-selects a default voice for the language when voice is not set.

skipTts.description: Set true if all scenes already have audio_path

topic.description: Overall topic/genre for visual aesthetic and background motion (e.g. "Kerala history", "crypto finance", "AI robotics")

style.description: Visual style/theme override (e.g. cinematic_documentary, finance_executive, cyber_tech, retro_synthwave, nature_organic, hype_sports, minimal_luxury, breaking_news, cosmic_space)

showCaptions.description: Display on-screen synchronized subtitles/captions. Default false (clean canvas without text unless explicitly requested in prompt).

showAnchor.description: Display on-screen anchor/presenter character. Default false (no anchor unless explicitly requested in prompt).

tools.name: multi_voice_tts
tools.description: Convert text to speech using any supported voice platform per-call. Overrides the global PROVIDER_TTS for this one request. Supports: edge-tts, voxforge, elevenlabs, azure, openai, webhook.

outputPath.description: Where to save the audio file (.m4a or .mp3)

platform.description: TTS platform. Overrides PROVIDER_TTS for this call. "voxforge" = github.com/amg555/voxforge; uses VOXFORGE_URL + VOXFORGE_KEY.

voice.description: Voice ID. edge-tts: e.g. en-US-GuyNeural. ElevenLabs: voice_id. Azure: short name. OpenAI: alloy/echo/fable/nova/onyx/shimmer.

rate.description: Speaking rate, e.g. "-10%" for slower, "+20%" for faster (edge-tts)

apiKey.description: API key for this call (optional — falls back to env var)

sceneIndex.description: Optional scene index for naming the output file

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll a queued pipeline job by jobId. Returns { status:"RUNNING"|"SUCCEEDED"|"FAILED", stage, result, error }. Call every 30s until SUCCEEDED. Required after queue_full_pipeline.

tools.name: queue_full_pipeline
tools.description: Queue a full video pipeline job (research → script → render → publish) on the worker API or any HTTP endpoint. Returns {jobId, status} immediately — poll get_job_status for completion. Set WORKER_API_URL to target the worker, or pass webhookUrl for any custom endpoint.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for TTS voice selection

channels.description: Delivery channels for the publish step: file | webhook

webhookUrl.description: HTTP endpoint to POST the job to. Overrides WORKER_API_URL env var.

payload.description: Additional fields forwarded to the worker

tools.name: scaffold_animation_project
tools.description:
Scaffold a code-driven HTML compositor project for high-quality animated video.
Every frame is a pure function of time t rendered by Playwright + ffmpeg — no AI image generation needed.
Copies the engine template into outDir and generates a starter edit.js from your scenes.

Use this when:
- You want Remotion-style motion graphics (kinetic text, springs, morphing layouts)
- You want broadcast-grade visual quality with zero diffusion artifacts
- The user asks for animated video, code-rendered video, or "make it look good"

After scaffolding, the agent edits edit.js in outDir to animate each scene, then calls render_animation.

outDir.description: Directory to scaffold the project into (created if absent)

scenes.description: Scene array from create_video_from_script / write_script. Each scene narration/caption/visual_description generates one layer() in edit.js.

title.description: Video title — written into edit.js reel() config

audioPath.description: Path to the mixed audio file to mux in (from multi_voice_tts or mix_audio.py)

tools.name: validate_storyboard
tools.description: Validate a STORYBOARD.md or storyboard.json against the four hard gates (event, non-overlapping reads, named transitions, no on-screen text). Returns { passed, errors, warnings }. Must pass before writing scene code.

tools.name: render_animation
tools.description:
Run the HTML compositor renderer on a scaffolded animation project.
Modes:
  "sheet"      — contact sheet (one frame every 0.5s), fast visual check of the whole film
  "stills"     — frames at specific timestamps (pass timestamps array)
  "strip"      — every frame in a time range (motion/transition check); pass timestamps as [start, end]
  "storyboard" — 4 keyframes at 0%, 33%, 66%, 100% of duration
  "crop"       — focal-point 9:16 mobile crop preview; pass timestamps as [aspect_ratio_string, t]
  "full"       — full render → out/<title>.mp4 (auto-runs purity verify gate first)
  "mux"        — re-mux audio only (no re-render, use after changing audio)
  "kit"        — export EDL/XML for Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve; run after "full"
  "look"       — pre-render linter (fonts, clipped text, NaN transforms, missing assets)
  "quality"    — closed-loop QA gate (1–10 score per frame, worst frames, pass/fail); the Opus 5.5 fix-loop entry point
  "golden"     — golden stills regression: use flags.save to capture baseline, flags.check to compare

Closed-loop QA fix protocol (Opus 5.5 / Claude Code pattern):
  1. render_animation({ mode: "quality" }) → { passed, overallScore, worstFrames: [{time, score, issues}] }
  2. If passed: false → fix ONLY the edit.js code paths at the failing timestamps.
  3. render_animation({ mode: "strip", timestamps: [failingT - 0.5, failingT + 0.5] }) to verify the fix visually.
  4. render_animation({ mode: "quality" }) again. Repeat max 3 rounds.
  5. NEVER re-render the full film to fix a single failing timestamp. Use strip only.

Review budget: at least one "sheet" per shot, one "strip" per key motion/transition, one "crop" per story-carrying face.
Returns { outputPath, passed, overallScore, worstFrames } for "quality"; { outputPath, passed } for "full"; { outputPath } for other modes.
Requires: npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium (one-time setup in projectDir).

timestamps.description: For mode="stills": [t1, t2, ...]. For mode="strip": [startSeconds, endSeconds]. For mode="crop": ["9:16", t]. For mode="sheet": omit or pass shot times.

audioPath.description: Audio file to mux in (for mode="full" or "mux")

crf.description: FFmpeg CRF quality (lower = better, larger file)

subframes.description: Motion-blur subframes per output frame (1 = none, 6 = 180° shutter). 6 subframes needed for fast morphs; adds ~6× render time.

skipVerify.description: Skip purity verification gate before full render (default: false — always verify).

goldenSave.description: For mode="golden": capture and save 4-keyframe baseline hashes to out/check/golden.json.

goldenCheck.description: For mode="golden": compare current 4 keyframes against saved golden.json baseline.

sampleRate.description: For mode="quality": samples per second to evaluate (default 2).

tools.name: export_to_editor
tools.description:
Import a FrameForge animation into an editing app and optionally apply editing operations.

Supported editors:
  "resolve"      — DaVinci Resolve 18.6+ built-in REST API. Enable in Preferences → System → General → "IP Remote Control". Port default: 8080.
  "premiere"     — Adobe Premiere Pro via CEP companion server. Full timeline editing via ExtendScript. Port default: 7777.
  "aftereffects" — After Effects via AE REST bridge. Import comp, add effects, render queue. Port default: 7878.
  "remotion"     — Remotion composition — patches props, triggers CLI render. Port default: 3001.
  "capcut"       — CapCut Desktop — import + export only (no programmatic edit API available). Port default: 9090.
  "custom"       — Any HTTP endpoint (pass editorUrl).

Actions (pass as "action" parameter):
  "import"       — Import the rendered MP4 (and EDL if present) into the editor. Default.
  "edit"         — Apply a list of operations to an existing timeline (see "operations").
  "render"       — Trigger the editor's own render/export pipeline.
  "status"       — Poll a previously started render job (pass jobId).

Operations (used with action="edit"):
  { op: "cut",        at: 4.5 }                          — add a cut at 4.5s
  { op: "trim",       clip: 0, startDelta: 0.5 }         — trim clip 0 start by +0.5s
  { op: "transition", between: [0,1], type: "dissolve", duration: 0.5 }
  { op: "color",      clip: 0, lut: "/path/to/lut.cube" }
  { op: "color",      clip: 0, grade: { lift: [0,0,0,0], gamma: [1,1,1,1], gain: [1,1,1,1] } }
  { op: "caption",    at: 2.0, duration: 3.0, text: "Hello", position: "bottom" }
  { op: "mute",       clip: 1 }
  { op: "speed",      clip: 0, factor: 0.5 }             — 50% slow-motion
  { op: "swap",       clip: 0, newPath: "/new/clip.mp4" } — replace a clip

action.description: What to do: import clip, apply edit operations, trigger render, or poll status

projectDir.description: FrameForge animation project directory. Required for action=import (finds the rendered MP4 and EDL automatically).

videoPath.description: Explicit MP4 path to import (overrides auto-detection from projectDir)

audioPath.description: Audio stem to import alongside the video

timelineName.description: Timeline/sequence name to create or target in the editor

operations.description: Edit operations for action="edit". Each op: { op, clip?, at?, between?, type?, duration?, text?, position?, lut?, grade?, factor?, newPath? }

jobId.description: Render job ID to poll (for action="status")

editorUrl.description: Override the editor bridge URL. Useful for non-default ports or remote bridges.

exportPath.description: Where the editor should save the export (for action="render")

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description:
Autonomous local video editor. Edit, cut, trim, speed-ramp, color-grade, reframe (16:9 landscape / 9:16 portrait / 1:1 square), add captions, apply xfade transitions, and mix clip audio with voiceover & ducked background music locally using FFmpeg. Fully autonomous — zero external APIs or subscriptions needed.

Features:
- Fast & frame-accurate trimming (start_time, end_time, duration).
- Speed ramping (0.25x to 4.0x) with audio pitch preserving (atempo).
- Cinematic color grading (cinematic, warm, cool, vintage, bw, vibrant, cyberpunk).
- Broadcast-quality captions with HarfBuzz text shaping & multilingual Indic/Malayalam support.
- Transitions: fade, dissolve, wipeleft, wiperight, slideup, slidedown, circleopen, smoothleft, etc.
- Multi-track audio: clip ambient audio volume control, master voiceover, and background music with sidechain ducking.
- Auto-fit mode: automatically calculates clip durations so video perfectly matches master audio length.

clips.description: Array of clip objects. Each clip: { video_path, start_time?, end_time?, duration?, speed?, clip_volume?, color_grade?, caption?, transition?, transition_duration?, audio_path? }

speed.description: Speed multiplier (e.g. 0.5 for 2x slow-mo, 1.5 for fast)

clip_volume.description: Volume of original clip audio (0 to mute, 1.0 normal)

caption.description: Caption text to burn into the lower third of this clip

transition.description: Transition into next clip (fade, dissolve, wipeleft, wiperight, slideup, slidedown, circleopen, none)

audio_path.description: Master voiceover / narration audio track across whole video

width.description: Custom canvas width (default 1920 for landscape, 1080 for portrait/square)

height.description: Custom canvas height (default 1080 for landscape, 1920 for portrait, 1080 for square)

color_grade.description: Global color grade fallback for all clips

auto_fit.description: Auto-adjust clip durations to match audio_path duration

output_path.description: Destination file path for the assembled MP4

tools.name: generate_scene_code
tools.description:
Generate pure-function-of-t JavaScript HTML5 Canvas drawing code for a scene.
Matches the Claude Opus 5.5 / ClaudeAnimationBase contract where every frame is a pure mathematical function of time t.
Returns the raw code and complete wrapped HTML ready for headless browser execution.

visual_description.description: Visual direction and motion description of the scene

style.description: Aesthetic / genre (cosmic_space, cyber_tech, cinematic_documentary, finance_executive, retro_synthwave, nature_organic, hype_sports, minimal_luxury, breaking_news, warm_creative)

language.description: Language code (e.g. en, ml, hi, ta)

tools.name: preview_scene
tools.description:
Render still frame previews (PNGs) of an animated scene at specified timestamps (default: 0.1s, duration/2, duration - 0.1s).
Allows the agent in Claude Code, Cursor, or any IDE to inspect the visual output, verify fonts, colors, and compositions, and patch the code before encoding. Satisfies Layer 3 verification loop.

code.description: Raw JavaScript canvas drawing code for window.seek(t)

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML page conforming to window.seek(t)

visual_description.description: Visual description (used to generate scene if code/html omitted)

timestamps.description: Timestamps in seconds to capture (default: [0.1, duration/2, duration - 0.1])

tools.name: verify_scene_quality
tools.description:
Run closed-loop visual QA grading (1–10 score) on an animated scene HTML file or code.
Evaluates 4 critical visual axes: content presence (non-blank), proper exposure (non-blown), layout distribution (not corner-confined), and continuous motion delta (detects stuck/frozen PowerPoint slides). Generates an optional contact sheet and returns frame-by-frame scores, worst frames, and pass/fail gate status.

htmlPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the scene HTML file

html.description: Inline HTML content if file not on disk

code.description: Raw JavaScript canvas drawing code (wrapped automatically if provided)

duration.description: Duration of scene in seconds (used if code/html wrapped)

sampleRate.description: Samples per second to evaluate (default: 2 fps)

sheetPath.description: Optional path where contact sheet image should be written

tools.name: plan_video_edit
tools.description:
Generate a structured Plan/Approve/Render video editing package for raw video footage.
Analyzes input clips, segments narrative beats, calculates cut in/out timestamps, assigns transitions, speed ramps, color grades, and audio cuts, and writes:
1. edit-plan.md — Human & agent readable decision list with rationale per cut, story beat breakdown, J/L-cut annotations, and director notes.
2. edit.json — Machine-executable configuration directly runnable via edit_video.
3. TREATMENT.md — Director's treatment document (8 sections: concept, tone, visual language, sound, narrative arc, shot list, delivery, notes).

J/L-cut support (lemo-opuscar DIRECTOR.md):
  J-cut: audio of the NEXT clip starts before its video cut (audio_offset < 0, e.g. -0.5s = audio precedes by 500ms)
  L-cut: current clip's audio extends over the next clip's video (audio_offset > 0 on next clip)

Professional audio rules applied:
  - First and last cuts always fade audio (no hard audio cuts at start/end)
  - Dialogue scenes: J-cut by 0.25–0.5s to soften edit
  - Action scenes: hard audio cut or L-cut to preserve momentum
  - Music-driven edits: snap cut points to speech pauses

footage.description: List of video file paths, or a directory path containing footage

goal.default: Create a dynamic polished montage highlighting key moments

target_duration.description: Desired total output duration in seconds

audio_path.description: Optional master voiceover narration audio path

output_dir.description: Directory to write edit-plan.md, edit.json and TREATMENT.md

bpm.description: Optional music BPM — when set, cut points snap to beat grid (HyperFrames beatAt formula)

generate_treatment.description: Generate TREATMENT.md director's document alongside edit-plan.md

tools.name: sync_upstream_skills
tools.description: Check and synchronize latest upstream skills, motion craft rules, film styles, and audio presets from 9 reference repositories (HyperFrames, OneTake, LemoOpuscar, CollageBroll, Remotion, Earshot, ClaudeAnimationBase, ClaudeRemotionSkill, FFmpegSkill). Makes network requests to GitHub API to check for new commits. Returns detailed per-category update summary. Use check_upstream_updates for a fast offline check of the last sync state.

tools.name: check_upstream_updates
tools.description: Check the last sync state of all upstream reference repositories (HyperFrames, OneTake, LemoOpuscar, CollageBroll, Remotion, Earshot, ClaudeAnimationBase, ClaudeRemotionSkill, FFmpegSkill). Fast, offline — reads the local manifest only (no network requests). Shows what was last synced, when, which repos had updates, and a human-readable changelog of what improved. To actually fetch new commits and update the manifest, use sync_upstream_skills. Agents and users can call this anytime to see if upstream skills have been updated since the last sync.

tools.name: transcribe_media
tools.description:
Transcribe speech from any audio or video file using OpenAI Whisper (local, free, no API key required).
Returns word-level timestamps for precise animation sync, SRT subtitles for closed captions, and silence/pause boundaries for intelligent cut alignment.
Supports: openai-whisper (local GPU/CPU), faster-whisper (CTranslate2), whisper-cli binary, or OpenAI Whisper API fallback.
Output formats: ndjson (one segment per line — used by engine.js captions()), srt (standard subtitle file), json (full word/segment data).
Use before writing edit.js to get cuePhrase() timestamps. Use on user-supplied footage to get cut points aligned to speech pauses.

mediaPath.description: Absolute path to audio or video file (mp4, mp3, m4a, wav, mov, webm)

model.description: Whisper model size (base = fast, small/medium = accurate)

language.description: BCP-47 language code hint (e.g. "en", "ml", "hi"). Auto-detected if omitted.

format.description: Output format: ndjson for engine.js captions(), srt for subtitle files, json for full data, all for everything

outputPath.description: Path to write output file. Auto-generated in .frameforge-files/transcripts/ if omitted.

tools.name: ingest_url
tools.description:
Download video or audio from any web URL to a local file using yt-dlp.
Supports YouTube, Vimeo, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, SoundCloud, direct MP4/MP3 URLs, and 1000+ other sites.
The downloaded file can then be passed to edit_video (video_path), multi_voice_tts (audio_path), transcribe_media, or any scene's video_path / audio_path field.
Requires yt-dlp: pip install yt-dlp   (or: winget install yt-dlp)

url.description: Web URL to download (YouTube, Vimeo, Twitter, direct MP4, etc.)

outputDir.description: Directory to save downloaded file. Defaults to .frameforge-files/downloads/

filename.description: Output filename without extension. Auto-generated from URL hash if omitted.

maxDuration.description: Maximum allowed duration in seconds (safety clamp, default 10 min)

subtitles.description: Also download subtitles / closed captions as SRT file

tools.name: mix_audio_pro
tools.description:
Professional audio post-production mixing — 15+ year sound engineer signal chain.

FULL CHAIN (in order):
 1. Noise gate: agate -60dBFS threshold — removes breath/room tone between words (enable with noiseGate: true)
 2. Pre-EQ: 80Hz HPF (remove proximity/rumble), 5kHz presence boost (+2dB), 12kHz air shelf (+1.5dB)
 3. De-esser: 6.5kHz dynamic suppression (-3dB) — removes harshness from "s", "sh", "ch"
 4. Voice compressor: 3:1 ratio, -20dBFS threshold, 5ms attack, 50ms release (broadcast standard)
 5. Room acoustics: 5 named profiles — studio_dry | broadcast | cinematic | concert_hall | intimate
    OR earshot forgeComputedRoom: "computed:sizeM:damp:earlyMs" (e.g. "computed:8:0.5:15" = 8m studio)
    (addReverb: true = cinematic profile; roomProfile overrides)
 6. Sidechain ducking: music ducks -18dB when voice active (40ms perceptual lead)
 7. Stereo widener: M/S extrastereo 1.4x on music layer only (voice stays mono-center)
 8. SFX timeline mixer: 13 synthesis types with millisecond accuracy
    Types: whoosh | impact | pop | click | riser | chime | buzz | tick | swish | punch | sparkle | deep_boom | transition
 9. Master bus: two-pass EBU R128 loudnorm at target LUFS, true peak ≤-1 dBTP
    Platform presets: youtube (-14) | podcast (-16) | broadcast (-23) | netflix (-27) | instagram (-14)

Outputs broadcast-ready 48kHz/192k AAC stereo.

voicePath.description: Primary narration / voice audio file (m4a, mp3, wav)

musicPath.description: Optional background music track. Will be looped, high-passed, and sidechain ducked.

musicVolume.description: Music volume multiplier before ducking (0.0–1.0, default 0.12)

duckLevel.description: Music attenuation in dB when voice is active (default -18dB)

sfxCues.description: Sound effect cues: [{ name, time, volume }]. Names: whoosh|impact|pop|click|riser|chime|buzz|tick|swish|punch|sparkle|deep_boom|transition

addReverb.description: Legacy: Add cinematic room acoustics. Prefer roomProfile for precise control.

roomProfile.description: Room acoustics profile. Named: studio_dry|broadcast|cinematic|concert_hall|intimate. Or earshot computed room: "computed:sizeM:damp:earlyMs" (e.g. "computed:8:0.5:15" = 8m room, 50% damp, 15ms early). Overrides addReverb.

noiseGate.description: Apply noise gate (-60dBFS threshold) to remove breath noise and room tone between words. Enable for field recordings or noisy VO.

stereoWiden.description: Apply mid-side stereo widening to music layer (voice stays mono-center).

targetLufs.description: Target integrated loudness. Platform presets: -14 YouTube/Instagram, -16 Podcast, -23 Broadcast EBU R128, -27 Netflix.

platform.description: Platform preset for LUFS target. Overrides targetLufs when provided.

videoPath.description: If provided, muxes the mixed audio into this video file and writes to outputPath.
